changeSet.author: pavlo_smahin
changeSet.comment: Relabel subfield $g of field 884 to "Conversion date/time"
changeSet.sql: WITH field_map AS ( SELECT f.id, f.tag, s.profile FROM field f JOIN specification s ON f.specification_id = s.id WHERE s.family = 'MARC' ) UPDATE subfield sf SET label = 'Conversion date/time' FROM field_map fm WHERE sf.field_id = fm.id AND sf.code = 'g' AND fm.tag = '884';

changeSet.author: pavlo_smahin
changeSet.comment: Mark obsolete subfields of fields 850, 7XX linking entries, and 5XX notes as deprecated
changeSet.sql: WITH field_map AS ( SELECT f.id, f.tag, s.profile FROM field f JOIN specification s ON f.specification_id = s.id WHERE s.family = 'MARC' ) UPDATE subfield sf SET deprecated = true FROM field_map fm WHERE sf.field_id = fm.id AND fm.profile = 'BIBLIOGRAPHIC' AND ( (sf.code IN ('b', 'd', 'e') AND fm.tag = '850') OR (sf.code = 'q' AND fm.tag IN ('760', '762', '765', '767', '770', '772', '775', '776', '777', '780', '785')) OR (sf.code = 'z' AND fm.tag IN ('515', '525', '530', '546', '547', '550')) );
